name: Kaya Akihiro
source:
“We should just kill him and put him in his grave. Why are you all hesitating?”

The school’s student council president. No matter who he’s speaking to, he always greets them with the same kind, unwavering smile. He’s part of a powerful political family, his father a respected attorney. Because of this, teachers are always careful around him. He’s the model student, both good at sports and with excellent grades, but underneath that, he has no interests and is indifferent to most things. The only thing close to a hobby is going jogging every morning and evening. He has an older brother who’s currently in hospital.
He’s cocky towards Kuboya, but is weak to Shiramine.

[Source: [url=http://www.tarhs.com/chara.html]official website profile[/url]]
